title: Las Meninas
clue: A young princess in a wide dress stands amid attendants and a dog in a large room, where a painter at a huge canvas looks out at the viewer and a mirror on the back wall reflects a royal couple.

title: Guernica
location: Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía, Madrid

title: The Night Watch (or The Militia Company of Captain Frans Banning Cocq)
The Persistence of Memory
location: Museum of Modern Art, New York City
clue: On a barren shoreline, limp pocket watches drape over a tree branch, a ledge, and a strange sleeping fleshy form, while ants swarm one closed watch.

title: The Scream
style: Expressionism; Oil, pastel, tempera on cardboard
clue: A figure with a skull-like face holds its head in its hands on a bridge, mouth open, under a swirling orange-red sky, while two figures walk away behind.

title: American Gothic
clue: A stern farmer holding a pitchfork stands beside a woman in a colonial-style apron in front of a white farmhouse with a pointed-arch window.

title: Nighthawks
clue: Three customers and a counterman in a corner diner at night, seen through a curved window from an empty street. Painted in 1942.

title: The Arnolfini Portrait
clue: A richly dressed couple hold hands in a Flemish bedroom with a small dog at their feet and a single lit candle in the chandelier, while a convex mirror on the back wall reflects two more figures.

title: The Great Wave off Kanagawa
location: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York City
clue: A breaking swell with claw-shaped crests curls over three boats of rowers, with snow-capped Mount Fuji small in the distance. A woodblock print from the Thirty-six Views series.

title: Liberty Leading the People
clue: A bare-breasted woman in a Phrygian cap raises a tricolour flag and a bayoneted musket as she leads armed men across a barricade strewn with the dead, a boy with pistols running beside her.

title: The Raft of the Medusa
clue: Survivors and corpses are heaped on a makeshift raft adrift at sea, the strongest waving a cloth at a tiny ship on the horizon. Based on a French frigate wrecked off West Africa in 1816.

title: The Garden of Earthly Delights
clue: A three-panel altarpiece: a calm paradise landscape with a man, woman, and their creator on the left, a teeming pastel field of nude figures with oversized fruit and birds in the centre, and a dark, fiery hell where musical instruments torment sinners on the right.
notes: Closed, its wings show The Creation of the World in grisaille.

title: Water Lilies
location: Museum of Modern Art, New York City

title: Les Demoiselles d'Avignon
location: Museum of Modern Art, New York City

title: The Treachery of Images (or This is Not a Pipe)
location: Los Angeles County Museum of Art, Los Angeles
clue: A carefully painted smoking pipe floats above a line of French text stating that it is not what it plainly appears to be.

title: Wanderer Above the Sea of Fog
clue: A man in a dark coat, seen from behind, stands on a rocky crag and gazes over a sea of fog toward distant peaks.

title: A Bar at the Folies-Bergère
clue: A barmaid stares out with a detached expression behind a marble counter of bottles and oranges, while a mirror behind her shows a crowded music hall and her own figure turned toward a top-hatted man.

title: The Death of Marat
location: Royal Museum of Fine Arts, Antwerp
clue: A dead man slumps in a bathtub, one arm hanging out with a quill still in his hand and a letter clutched in the other, a knife on the floor beside a wooden crate used as a desk.

title: Marilyn Diptych
style: Pop Art; Silkscreen ink and acrylic on canvas
clue: Fifty copies of one publicity photograph of an actress, silkscreened across two panels: brightly coloured on the left, black and white and fading on the right. Made weeks after her death in 1962.
